a:r.a:t: REVISION NOTE: The PSC XI deck requirements list “Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) Priority” as item 2, and the old deck had no SDG slide. The concept note names SDG 3, 4 and 9 equally. A “priority” should be one goal, so SDG 3 leads and is tied to three specific targets: 3.4 (premature NCD mortality, which covers heart disease and chronic respiratory disease), 3.8 (universal health coverage) and 3.c (health workforce). SDG 9 and SDG 4 are shown as supporting. Colours follow the UN SDG palette (no UN logos used). Placed right after the problem so the judges see why it matters globally before they see who you serve. SCRIPT (0:15): That’s why our priority is SDG 3, Good Health and Well-being: cutting premature deaths from heart and lung disease, bringing quality care to the primary level, and equipping the health workers who deliver it. Along the way we build affordable health tech locally, which is SDG 9, and train future nurses and doctors, which is SDG 4.
